herenow.apiKey: YOUR_HERENOW_API_KEY (or set HERENOW_API_KEY in the environment instead)

site.siteUrl: OPTIONAL: https://YOUR-SITE-SLUG.example (defaults to the here.now slug URL)

submissions.approverNote: Who approves listings (placeholder: the store owner). Change here or override in config.local.json.

reservedIds.note: Reserved for the store owner's own apps.

submissions.stateFile: OPTIONAL: a path outside the repo (default: ~/.aipp-store/submissions-state.json)
submissions.privateTermsNote: Put private names and terms to block (family words, real usernames, league or pet names) in config.local.json only, never here.
